numeric.arithmetic: Python complex binary64, platform libm trig
numeric.serialization: Python shortest roundtrip JSON floats;replay pinned runtime;zero retained,no clipping
numeric.normalization: Verify norm within1e-12;retain raw Born probabilities;sampling CDF divides explicitly by measured norm;no input state injection

indexing: q0 LSB;bitstrings q(n-1)..q0;ascending state index;identity qi->ci terminal mapping only

schema.event: kind bitstring,value exact n-bit string OR kind qubit_one,value integer qubit index
schema.shots: null for simulate/reference;positive integer for sample/compare;report chooses compare when shots supplied else simulate

prng.algorithm: For each draw: x ^= (x<<13)&0xffffffff; x ^= x>>17; x ^= (x<<5)&0xffffffff; x &=0xffffffff;u=x/4294967296.0. One draw per shot.
prng.sampling: Event indices first ascending,then complement ascending;CDF normalized by verified norm;strict u<cumulative;last positive cell absorbs only roundoff residual.
prng.streams: common:comparator_seed equals seed; independent:distinct seeds. All events use event-first CDF so Bernoulli u

statistics: iid analytic population expectation/variance/SE;PRNG emulates iid model,not physical randomness;no confidence interval certified
resources: Gate depth critical path per touched qubit;id counts one;no measurement depth;AE oracle calls null/not applicable;actual measurements in separate versioned artifact
report: Canonical sorted JSON UTF8 SHA256 semantic input/profile/catalog/report;normalized LF code hash;Markdown exact embedded JSON with safe fence. Raw input bytes CLI corpus separately hashes.
